newsitem.title: USA: NJ Transit adopts $590 mln capital budget.
newsitem.headline: NJ Transit adopts $590 mln capital budget.

text.p: New Jersey Transit said its board has adopted a $590 million capital program for the year ending June 30, 1998.

The state transportation agency said the fiscal 1998 capital program is submitted to the state legislature for consideration as part of its annual appropriations process and to various metropolitan planning organizations throughout the state whose approvals are required as a prerequisite to federal grant awards.

NJTransit said the budget assumes that the federal Intermodal Surface Transportation Efficiency Act will be renewed at current levels and that funding from the state's Transportation Trust Fund also will remain unchanged.
The federal legislation expires September 30, at the end of fiscal 1997, the state agency noted.
